dedupe_keys.name: china ldrl china s surface water bodies large dams reservoirs and lakes dataset

description: The China-LDRL dataset research team publishes geospatial layers of large dams, reservoirs, lakes and surface-water bodies across China. The repository describes analysis of 19,338 Landsat images from 2019 in Google Earth Engine, supplemented by very-high-resolution Google Earth imagery. Figshare exposes Shapefile component files for the separate feature layers in version 3. Access is open and free under CC-BY-4.0. The mapped water extent reflects the imagery and processing period; it does not supply continuous water levels, reservoir operating rules or a complete hydraulic network. Exact spatial resolution and layer attribute definitions were not established from the landing metadata. The layers could help locate impoundments and receiving waters for flood exposure, water-allocation or reservoir-network simulations after adding the required engineering attributes. They complement data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs with a China-focused interpretation of dams and water bodies. Differences in feature definitions and observation dates need checking before joining the inventories.
